items.prompt: Evening at a window of an old dacha: a man seen from behind sits on the sill looking out at a dark forest, and the trees outside are rendered like overlapping frames of a film, slightly offset, as if the world were a sequence of stills.

alt.ru: Вечер у окна старой дачи: мужчина со спины смотрит на тёмный лес, а деревья за окном двоятся, как наложенные кадры плёнки.
alt.en: Evening at a dacha window: a man from behind looks at a dark forest, the trees outside doubled like overlapping film frames.
alt.pt: Fim de tarde à janela de uma dacha: um homem de costas olha a floresta escura, as árvores lá fora duplicadas como fotogramas sobrepostos.
alt.es: Atardecer en la ventana de una dacha: un hombre de espaldas mira un bosque oscuro, los árboles duplicados como fotogramas superpuestos.
